full_prompt_en: A square character illustration shows a smiling cartoon boy against a brilliant orange background crossed by turquoise and yellow paint splashes. The background is almost flat orange, but broad rough strokes enter diagonally from the upper left and sweep behind the head. Turquoise paint breaks into small droplets at the left edge, while a streak of sunny yellow runs along the upper right. The boy stands near the center from tousled hair to the lower torso. His large head tilts slightly, and his spiky light-brown hair lifts in irregular soft clumps. Wide green eyes, a rounded pink nose, prominent ears, and a small crooked smile give the face an open, mischievous expression. Pale skin is softly modeled with warm blush on the cheeks and nose. He wears a loose teal-green open jacket over an orange shirt with a small central graphic mark. Dark piping along the neck and sleeve openings adds a narrow outline without making the clothing rigid. His arms hang loosely at his sides, and the bottom of the figure is cropped by the frame. To the right of his head is a large yellow hand-lettered word; its stylized strokes are partly ambiguous, so the image reads primarily as a decorative signature-like mark. A small purple paint patch enters behind the left side of the jacket near the lower edge. The character has rounded three-dimensional shading and lightly textured surfaces, while the background marks remain flatter, rougher, and more spontaneous. Broad even light from the front and upper left brightens the face and hair, leaving only soft small shadows under the chin and around the jacket folds. The overall composition is playful and direct, using a friendly central silhouette against energetic complementary paint fields.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形角色插画呈现一名微笑的卡通男孩，背后是亮橙色底域，青绿色与黄色泼漆从中掠过。背景大体为平坦橙色，但宽阔粗糙的笔痕从左上斜入，扫过头后。青绿色颜料在左边缘裂成小滴，阳光般的黄色痕迹沿右上延伸。男孩从凌乱头发到下半身占据中央。大头微微倾斜，浅棕色刺翘头发分成不规则的柔软簇。睁大的绿眼、圆粉鼻、突出的耳朵和一丝歪斜笑容让面孔显得开放而顽皮。浅色皮肤柔和塑形，面颊和鼻尖带暖红晕。他穿一件宽松、敞开的青绿色外套，里面是橙色上衣，胸前有一处小图形痕迹。领口和袖口的深色细边添入窄轮廓，却不让衣服显得僵硬。双臂松散垂在身侧，人物下方被画框裁断。头部右边有一处黄色大型手写字样；笔画风格化而部分难辨，因此主要读作装饰性签名般痕迹。下缘附近，一片紫色颜料从外套左后方进入。角色带有圆润的三维明暗与轻微肌理，背景痕迹则更平、更粗糙、更即兴。宽广均匀的光从前方略偏左上照亮面孔与头发，只在下巴和外套褶处留下一点柔影。整体构图俏皮而直接，用友善的中央剪影对照充满活力的互补色颜料区域。
style_prompt_en: The character illustration combines rounded, softly shaded volume with flat, unruly paint gestures. A hot orange field dominates, interrupted by broad turquoise sweeps, sunny yellow strokes, and a small purple accent. Smooth facial modeling and gently grainy fabric sit in front of splattered, rough-edged marks, giving the focal form more clarity than the surrounding field. Exaggerated proportions, open curves, and a few narrow dark outlines keep the silhouette instantly legible. Front-facing light is bright and forgiving, with soft shallow shadows rather than dramatic depth. Diagonal background strokes add energy behind a stable centered form, and scattered droplets carry that motion to the edges. Saturation is high but organized by large color areas. The overall effect is youthful and upbeat, balancing tactile painted spontaneity with polished cartoon expression.
style_prompt_zh: 这种角色插画把圆润、柔和塑形的体积与平坦而不羁的颜料动作结合起来。炽热橙色域占主导，被宽阔青绿扫痕、阳光黄笔触和一小块紫色重音打断。平滑的面部塑形与轻微颗粒的织物立在泼溅、粗边的痕迹之前，让焦点形体比周围色域更清楚。夸张比例、开放曲线和少数细深轮廓使剪影立即可辨。正面光明亮而宽容，只有柔浅阴影，没有戏剧性深度。斜向背景笔痕在稳定居中的形体后注入能量，散落液滴把动势带到边缘。饱和度很高，却由大色块组织。整体效果年轻而欢快，平衡可触的颜料即兴感与精致的卡通表情。
theme_en: A smiling cartoon boy before an orange background with turquoise paint splashes
theme_zh: 一名微笑的卡通男孩站在橙色背景与青绿泼漆前
name: Nickelodeon
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
